title: An Unconditional Declaration of Love — Part 6

series.summary: Rentaro unleashes an impassioned, unstoppable confession, praising every single aspect of Karane's body, personality, and tsundere charm. Overcome with tears of joy, Karane shares a passionate kiss with Rentaro before Hakari, Shizuka, and Nano join them in the steaming spa, united forever.

segments.description: Rentaro passionately speaks to Karane, gesturing with fiery conviction as he praises her entire being.
segments.voiceover_text: Looking straight into Karane's eyes, Rentaro passionately declares that he loves every single curve, flaw, and tsundere quirk she possesses.

segments.description: Karane's face flushes scarlet as huge tears spill from her eyes, her insecurities melting away completely.
segments.voiceover_text: Hearing his unabashed, unconditional worship, Karane's icy walls shatter into overwhelming tears of absolute, euphoric relief and gratitude.

segments.description: Rentaro gently leans in and kisses Karane on the lips by the quiet poolside, their silhouettes glowing.
segments.voiceover_text: Leaning softly closer, Rentaro seals his eternal vow with an unforgettable romantic kiss, wiping away every trace of doubt.

segments.description: Hakari, Shizuka, and Nano join Rentaro and Karane in the warm spa bath, smiling and laughing together.
segments.voiceover_text: Hakari, Shizuka, and Nano warmly embrace them in the steaming hot tub, welcoming Karane back with pure family love.

segments.description: The five soulmates sit together in the steaming water against the evening sky, happy and completely inseparable.
segments.voiceover_text: Surrounded by steaming waters and glowing smiles, the Rentaro Family stands closer, stronger, and more deeply in love than ever.
